🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 31, 2026

Moon, at home in Cancer, holds a trine to Mercury, in Scorpio. Two water placements agreeing on the terms: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Cancer, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Fire moves first and pays first. A week ago Mars was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. From Cancer, Moon hands you an opening. Earth keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. The Scorpio chapter closed four weeks ago.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Venus trines you from Libra, meeting no resistance. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. The square to Jupiter that held a week ago has let go.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is on home ground in Cancer. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, and the ease asks its own attention. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Mercury in Scorpio stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fire holds on, and the holding is billed. Sun has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon sextiles you from Cancer: a door left ajar. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Retrograde since two weeks ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. Moon squares you from Cancer, and something has to give way. Air opens the file, and the file has a price. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Cancer sides with you before you have argued. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. In four weeks Mars has moved 15°, small enough to feel like nothing.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Venus in Libra opens a gap you have to step into. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, has no support in Aries and asks twice for half. Moon in Cancer sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Cardinal earth meets a bill. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. Sun in Scorpio squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Mercury in Scorpio trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Mutable water keeps two accounts, and both balance. Mercury let go of it a week ago.
